rationale: All three lenses ran. All 9 acceptance criteria pass. Standards checks pass (branch name and commit message match project CI patterns). Blind lens false-positives dismissed (truncated diff artefact and already-guarded mapping field). Edge-case concerns deferred: the missing filterOptions dep in the revalidation useEffect is practically safe because filterOptions is loaded on mount before the user can select a domain, and revalidateSelections is a no-op when filterOptions is null. The Valtio snapshot frozen-array reference is consumed immediately via .map() so no mutation path exists. The length-equality guard in the component is mathematically equivalent to value equality for a pure-filter (subset-only) operation. One deferred note for future maintainers: if revalidateSelections is ever extended to add or substitute items (not just filter), the length guard in ActivityEventsPage.tsx should be replaced with a value-equality check.
